name: videogen
description: Official VideoGen MCP server for creating and editing videos, images, voiceovers, music, and avatars, with media uploads, project edits, and video exports.

VIDEOGEN_API_KEY.description: VideoGen API key for local stdio or bearer authentication. Never commit your key. Generation uses account credits.

npm.description: Local stdio. Requires Node.js 20+ and a VideoGen account with credits.

http.description: Hosted Streamable HTTP. Use an OAuth-capable MCP client and sign in to VideoGen. Generation uses account credits.
